Subject: Action items — Grayline workshop (9/14) — day-of checklist

Team — final coordination notes (short checklist so we can triage before Monday):

1) Marissa — Badging & reception (owner)
   - Reserve two short-term parking passes (covering 08:30–10:30) and send exact spot numbers to Kayla.
   - Print visitor badges and have a mobile scanner at reception for signed NDAs.
   - Be the lobby escort POC; wear the red "Visitor Escort" lanyard.

2) Connor — Room & AV (owner)
   - Reserve Conference Room A3 09:00–16:00 (primary) and Conference Room B1 09:00–12:00 (backup).
   - Confirm projector, HDMI, spare Mac/USB-C dongle, and a room laptop with latest demo image.
   - Put ConferenceRoom_A3_AVChecklist.pdf on the room tablet and email a link to Kayla.

3) Vivek — Network & demo infra (owner)
   - Pre-provision VPN accounts for Marcus Lee and Priya Nair; provide credentials by Monday 12:00.
   - Whitelist Grayline source IP range and open ports required for the demo cluster (I’ll DM you the port list).
   - Ensure a rollback snapshot of the demo model v2.1 is available in case we need to switch.

4) Catering & dietary
   - Once Kayla confirms allergies, place the lunch order (sandwich trays + two warm options) and mark gluten-free.

5) NDA & DocuSign
   - I’ve sent the DocuSign link to procurement; if they return a signed PDF, we’ll add to the visitor folder and print a copy for reception.

Calendar: I created a calendar event "Grayline — Workshop (Redwood Campus)" and invited all attendees; please confirm you accepted. Event ID: CAL-20270914-GLY.

Thanks — shout if anything missing.
Neha
